hints.title: Fibonacci Sequence for Valid Binary Strings
hints.text: Count binary strings without consecutive ones of length k; this count follows the standard Fibonacci recurrence.

hints.title: Prefix Construction from Most Significant Bit
hints.text: Traverse bits of n from highest to lowest. When a one bit is met, add ways to form numbers with zero at that position.

hints.title: Digit Decomposition and Early Termination
hints.text: Precompute Fibonacci counts up to bit 30. Iterate downward through bits of n. When bit i is 1, add fib[i]. If the preceding bit was also 1, break early because all valid integers under n have been accounted for. If loop completes, add 1 for n itself.

complexity.notes: Optimal 32-bit digit counting following Fibonacci recurrence.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking every integer from 0 to N takes O(N) which exceeds time limits for N up to 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precomputing 32 Fibonacci values enables bitwise prefix counting in 30 steps.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Connect binary strings without adjacent ones to Fibonacci numbers and apply digit prefix counting.
